project_name: SI-JADWAL & PRESENSI RUANGAN PUSKESMAS (Aplikasi Penyusun Jadwal Kegiatan Luar & Tracking Keluar-Masuk Pegawai)
app_type: dashboard / internal government health clinic tool
design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY HEALTH INSTITUTION (Trust, Precision, Health & Government Standards)

typography.font_pairing_strategy: Official Indonesian Health Standard - Modern Editorial Hybrid
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, monospace (For NIP, Kode Ruangan, & Tanggal)
font_rules: Headings MUST use Plus Jakarta Sans with tight tracking (tracking-tight) for an authoritative government health institution feel.
Body text MUST use Work Sans with clean line height (leading-relaxed) for optimal legibility.
DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings.
H1 size ceiling: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl (DO NOT exceed text-5xl).

colors.palette_name: Puskesmas Emerald & Slate Official Light Palette

top_header_and_navigation.title: Sistem Informasi Jadwal Luar & Presensi Ruangan Puskesmas
top_header_and_navigation.role_switcher: Peran Aktif: [Petugas Operational / Staf TU] | [Kepala TU] | [Kepala Puskesmas]
top_header_and_navigation.date_selector: Live Filter Tanggal Presensi Ruangan & Kegiatan
top_header_and_navigation.quick_stats_bar: Summary counter: Total Pegawai, Di Dalam Gedung, Kegiatan Luar, Menunggu Approval

feature_1_dashboard_keluar_masuk_ruangan.description: Papan Status Real-time Keluar/Masuk Pegawai per 13 Ruangan Puskesmas.
feature_1_dashboard_keluar_masuk_ruangan.layout: Bento Grid Cards / Table View dengan Switcher per Klaster / Ruangan.
room_card_content: Badge Jumlah Pegawai: Hadir di Gedung vs Tugas Luar
Daftar Pegawai Di Dalam Gedung (Lengkap dengan Nama, NIP, Jabatan, Avatar)
Daftar Pegawai Tugas Luar (Lengkap dengan Nama, NIP, Nama Kegiatan Luar, Lokasi, Status Approval)

feature_2_manajemen_pegawai.description: CRUD Pegawai + Import dari Excel, PDF, Word.
feature_2_manajemen_pegawai.import_modal: File dropzone supporting .xlsx, .xls, .pdf, .docx, .doc, .csv with parser preview and validation table before saving.

feature_3_penyusunan_jadwal_kegiatan_lua.description: Form Tambah/Edit Kegiatan Luar dengan Blokir Total Bentrok Tanggal (Strict Double-Date Validation).
feature_3_penyusunan_jadwal_kegiatan_lua.conflict_validation_rule: Sistem secara otomatis mengecek seluruh jadwal terdaftar untuk pegawai yang dipilih. Jika pegawai sudah memiliki agenda tugas luar / kegiatan pada rentang tanggal yang dipilih, tombol SIMPAN DIBLOKIR TOTAL dan muncul banner Peringatan Merah dengan detail bentrok.
fields: Nama Kegiatan Luar (misal: Posyandu Balita / Bulan Imunisasi Anak Sekolah / Pusling / Pelatihan)
Pegawai yang Ditugaskan (Multi-select / Single select dengan indikator status tanggal)

feature_4_import_jadwal_file.description: Import Jadwal Kegiatan Luar dari Excel / PDF / Word.
features: Preview Tabel Extracted Data sebelum Submit
Deteksi Bentrok Otomatis pada file import (Baris yang bentrok akan di-highlight merah dengan opsi 'Lewati' atau 'Ganti Pegawai')

feature_5_panel_approval.description: Persetujuan Satu Tahap oleh Kepala TU atau Kepala Puskesmas.
functionality: Filter berdasarkan status: Menunggu Approval, Disetujui, Ditolak
Notifikasi Sonner Toast saat approval berhasil diselesaikan

feature_6_kalender_and_timeline.description: Tampilan Kalender Bulanan & Timeline Mingguan Kegiatan Luar Pegawai.
features: Click to view detail modal kegiatan

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: All React component files in frontend/src/ are JavaScript (.js / .jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx). Use standard JSX syntax.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for all CRUD actions, import success, and approval state updates.
Implement strict double-date conflict detection on client-side state and backend API. Show clear visual feedback if a staff member is assigned on an overlapping date.
Support file import parsing simulation for Excel, PDF, and Word documents in frontend with parsed preview tables and dummy sample generators so users can test immediately.
Ensure all 13 Puskesmas rooms listed in rooms_list are present in the room tracking dashboard with accurate counts of inside vs outside personnel.
Include role switcher buttons (Petugas TU, Kepala TU, Kepala Puskesmas) at the header so anyone can test approval workflows without needing a login wall.

Every key interactive element MUST contain clear data-testid attributes formatted in lower-kebab-case (e.g., data-testid="btn-tambah-jadwal", data-testid="room-card-ruang-tu", data-testid="approval-approve-btn-{id}").
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never center align the main application container.
Do NOT use universal transition 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions on hover/focus.
Use generous padding and spacing (p-6, p-8) on cards and containers with borders.
Maintain high APCA text contrast against light backgrounds (minimum 4.5:1).
Keep icons clean using lucide-react or phosphor icons. No emoji-only icons.
